kind: research workflow skill/template and static evidence viewer

runtime.execution: Host coordinator loads role skills; MyST transforms files into a widget. No provider/agent scheduler source.
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes host delegation, artifact/version, execution, literature APIs and MyST; does not own the host engine.

summary: a staged actor/critic/validator protocol, evidence schemas and static viewer

inspection.scope: orchestrator v29 role/continuation/gate protocols, evidence validator specification and evidence-explorer loader/view
inspection.limits: Host enforcement, provider loop, original app database and runtime tests are unavailable.

actions.name: generate_plan(plan_content=...) / update_step_status
actions.input: Validated scope plan entries and step state
actions.lifecycle: Prescribed external memory across compaction; host owns lifetime and approval
actions.authority: Coordinator; initial approval and exceptional signoff are authored requirements

actions.name: delegate_to(agent=..., task=...) / send_message
actions.input: Role, skills, explicit artifact/version inputs and complete task string
actions.output: Child findings, gate JSON, artifact/version handles
actions.lifecycle: New independent-validator and bounded-continuation frames; actors receive fixes
actions.authority: Host API; prompt-defined separation, no enforcement source

actions.name: section_NN_evidence_package.json
actions.input: Findings/source sentences/DOIs/access labels; conflicts, figures, gaps
actions.output: Per-section packages consumed by static viewer
actions.lifecycle: Files can survive context; optional aggregate does not drive viewer

actions.name: Evidence Explorer directive + filters
actions.surface: Implemented static build transform and UI
actions.lifecycle: Rebuilt from files; no live DB service; fixed section range
actions.authority: Build filesystem access and public browser

actions.name: gate_evidence_compliance.json
actions.input: Evidence records, DOI metadata and scoped parameters
actions.lifecycle: Saved gate and bounded fix loops; prescribed downstream block on fail
actions.authority: Separate validator frame; exceptions via signoff

authority.detail: Model roles do artifact work; protocol requires initial plan approval and failed-gate signoff; no engine enforcement traced.

evaluation.detail: Authored mechanical checks and separate judgment frames. Fulltext source-not-in-abstract is not body-substring verification; metadata/size/count proxies do not establish entailment.

time_order.detail: Certified version IDs replace chronologically latest content to prevent publication races; not core clock.

evidence.claim: Role separation and prompt/plan materialization are authored host-operation instructions, not an implemented scheduler.
Fresh validator/continuation frames, findings budgets and compaction task-construction workaround are prescribed.
Canonical artifact VIDs, save-after-write race and fail/signoff transitions are authored workflow contracts.
Evidence schema and per-section files; optional combined database is not read by the viewer.
Build loader hardcodes sections02–13, skips unreadable/missing files and serializes findings/conflicts into widget.
Browser filters loaded findings by claim/DOI/system/key, section and tier; renders first200 matches.
Authored mechanical DOI/source/size/count/schema proxies and pass/fail artifact; semantic correctness remains separate.

tests.focus: Authored check specification; not executable suite
tests.oracle: DOI/source/schema/count checks bound metadata faults; heuristics can reject valid body/abstract overlap and do not prove entailment. Not executed.

strengths: Explicit role/input/output contracts, bounded continuation and canonical content maps.
Source sentences/access scope retained with normalized claims.
limits: Barriers/transitions are authored instructions, not demonstrated access controls.
Viewer fixedsection02–13 skips missing files; claim counts do not establish truth.
arconaut_questions: Can role frames and certified maps become executable host programs with real enforcement?
How should evidence schemas join original audit while preserving source and uncertainty?
